Key Concepts:
- Propositional Logic
- Predicate Logic
- $A \wedge B$

This chapter covers key concepts in combinatorics, including Balls In Bins, general Combinatory methods, Counting, Generating Functions, Modular Arithmetic, Pigeonhole Principle, Recurrence Relations, and Summation techniques.
This chapter covers Graph Theory fundamentals, including Counting, Degrees of Graphs, Graph Algorithms, Graph Coloring, and Graph Connectivity.
List of subtopics including Graph Isomorphism, Matching, Planarity, Jaccard Coefficient, and various algorithms.
Covers Propositional Logic, First Order Logic (Predicate Logic), and Logical Reasoning (Inference) along with rules of inference and equivalences.
Covers Set Theory, Relations, Functions, Binary Operation, and Group Theory with definitions, properties, and problem-solving techniques.
Quick Formula Reference includes sections on Limits, Continuity, Differentiation, Maxima Minima, Integration (Indefinite), Definite Integral, Polynomials, and Summation.

Comprehensive review topics including Cartesian Coordinates, Determinant, Eigen Value, Gaussian Elimination, LU Decomposition, Matrix, Multiplicity, Orthonormality, Rank of Matrix, Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), Statistics, Subspace, System of Equations, and Vector Space.
Key concepts covered: Bayes Theorem, Bayesian Network, Bernoulli Distribution, Binomial Distribution, Chi Square Distribution, and Conditional Probability.
This page lists the subsections of Chapter 8 (Logical Reasoning) and the beginning of Chapter 9 (Quantitative Aptitude) along with their corresponding page numbers.

Topic-wise Key Concepts: 1. 3D Structure, 2. Assembling, 3. Assembling Pieces, 4. Counting Figure, 5. Grouping, 6. Image Rotation, 7. Mirror Image, 8. Paper Folding, 9. Patterns In Three Dimensions, 10. Patterns In Two Dimensions

Topic-wise Key Concepts: Antonyms, Articles, Comparative Forms, English Grammar, Grammatical Error, Incorrect Sentence Part, Most Appropriate Word, Narrative Sequencing, Noun Verb Adjective, Passage Reading, Phrasal Verb
